name: Bodyweight squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Lower your hips back and down while keeping your chest up, then drive through heels to return.

name: Standard push-up
instructions: Start in a high plank position. Lower your chest until it nearly touches the floor, keeping elbows at 45 degrees, then press back up.

name: Forearm plank
instructions: Rest on your forearms and toes. Keep your body in a rigid straight line from head to heels, engaging your glutes and core.

name: Glute bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Drive through your heels to raise your hips until thighs and torso align.

name: Walking lunge
instructions: Step forward with one leg and lower hips until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees. Push off front foot to transition into next step.

name: Jumping jacks
instructions: Jump feet out wide while swinging arms overhead in a smooth rhythmic motion, then return to starting stance.

name: High knees
instructions: Run in place bringing knees up toward chest level rapidly while pumping arms to maintain cardiovascular tempo.

name: Burpee
instructions: From standing drop into a squat thrust, kick feet back to plank, do a push-up, jump feet forward and leap vertically.

name: Mountain climbers
instructions: From a high plank position, drive alternating knees toward chest at a rapid controlled pace while keeping hips stable.

name: Pull-up
instructions: Grip bar overhand slightly wider than shoulder-width. Pull chest up toward the bar, retracting shoulder blades, then lower under control.

name: Dumbbell bench press
instructions: Lie on bench holding dumbbells at chest level. Press upward until arms are extended, then slowly lower dumbbells back down.

name: Single-arm dumbbell row
instructions: Support one knee and hand on bench. Hold dumbbell in free hand and row elbow straight up alongside torso, squeezing back muscles.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: Stand or sit tall with dumbbells at ear height. Press weights overhead until arms are straight, keeping core tightly braced.

name: Goblet squat
instructions: Hold a kettlebell close against chest with both hands. Perform a deep controlled squat keeping torso upright.

name: Kettlebell swing
instructions: Hinge at hips with knees slightly bent. Swing kettlebell back between legs then snap hips explosively to swing weight to chest height.

name: Barbell back squat
instructions: Rest barbell across upper traps. Squat down until thighs are parallel to floor while keeping spine neutral, then drive upward.

name: Barbell deadlift
instructions: Stand with barbell over midfoot. Grip bar, flatten back, and drive through floor using legs and hips to stand upright with weight.

name: Resistance band row
instructions: Loop band around feet or fixed anchor. Pull handles towards ribcage, squeezing shoulder blades together, then slowly release.

name: Resistance band pull-apart
instructions: Hold band in front of chest at shoulder width. Pull arms apart horizontally until band touches chest, then return smoothly.

name: Cat-cow stretch
instructions: On hands and knees, gently alternate between arching back toward ceiling and dropping belly while lifting chest.

name: Seated hamstring stretch
instructions: Sit with one leg extended and hinge gently at hips toward foot without rounding spine aggressively until gentle tension is felt.

name: Kneeling hip flexor stretch
instructions: Kneel on one knee with opposite foot flat in front. Gently shift weight forward while keeping torso upright to open hip flexors.

name: Single-leg balance stand
instructions: Stand tall on one leg with soft knee. Focus eyes on a fixed point and hold balance for 30 seconds per side.

name: Pike push-up
instructions: Assume downward dog position with hips high. Bend elbows to lower crown of head toward floor, then press back up strongly.
